snippet.title: Empyrion Galactic Survival - Game Trailer (updated)
snippet.description:
Empyrion - Galactic Survival is a 3D open world space sandbox survival adventure. Build powerful ships, mighty space stations and vast planetary settlements to explore, conquer or exploit a variety of different planets and discover the mysteries of Empyrion!

The game is currently in development by Eleon Game Studios.

Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/383120
Forums: https://www.empyriongame.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/empyrion
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/empyriongame
Twitter: https://twitter.com/EmpyrionGame
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/EmpyrionGame
